sn35.247:1.1: Seyyathāpī bhikkhave puriso arugatto pakkagatto saravanam paviseyya ||
sn35.247:1.2: tassa kusakaṇṭakā ceva pāde vijjheyyuṃ arūpakkāni gattāni vilikkheyyuṃ || evaṃ
sn35.247:1.3: hi so bhikkhave puriso bhiyyosomattāya tatonidānam dukkhadomanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha ||
sn35.247:1.4: Evaṃ eva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu gāmagato vā araññagato vā labhati vattāram
sn35.247:1.5: ayañ ca kho āyasmā evaṃkārī evaṃsamācāro asucigāmakaṇṭako ti ||
sn35.247:1.6: taṃkaṇṭako ti viditvā saṃvaro ca asaṃvaro ca veditabbo || || 4
sn35.247:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe adhimuccati || appiyarūpe rūpe vyāpajjati || anupaṭṭhitakāyasatī ca viharati parittacetaso ||
sn35.247:2.3: tañca cetovimuttim paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti || yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti ||
sn35.247:2.8: Manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme adhimuccati || appiyarūpe dhamme vyāpajjatī anupaṭṭhitakāyasatī ca viharati parittacetaso
sn35.247:2.9: tañ ca cetovimuttim paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti || yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti || || 5
sn35.247:3.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso chappāṇake gahetvā nānāvisaye nānāgocare daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya ||
sn35.247:3.8: Daḷhāya rajjuyā bandhitvā majjhe gaṇṭhiṃ karitvā ossajjeyya || ||
sn35.247:3.9: Atha kho te bhikkhave chappāṇakā nānāvisayā nānāgocarā sakaṃ sakaṃ gocaravisayam āviñcheyyuṃ ||
sn35.247:3.10: ahi āviñcheyya vammikaṃ pavekkhāmī ti || suṃsumāro āviñcheyya udakaṃ pavekkhāmīti || pakkhī āviñcheyya ākāsaṃ ḍessāmīti || kukkuro āviñcheyya gāmaṃ pavekkhāmīti || sigālo āviñcheyya sīvathikaṃ pavekkhāmīti || makkaṭo āviñcheyya vanam pavekkhāmīti || ||
sn35.247:3.11: Yadā kho te bhikkhave chappāṇakājhattā assu kilantā || atha kho yo nesam pāṇakānaṃ balavataro assa || tassa te anuvatteyyuṃ anuvidhīyeyyuṃ vasaṃ gaccheyyuṃ || ||
sn35.247:3.12: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kāyagatā sati abhāvitā abahulikatā || taṃ cakkhu āviñchati manāpiyesu rūpesu amanāpiyā rūpā paṭikkulā honti || pa ||
sn35.247:3.13: mano āviñchati manāpiyesu dhammesu amanāpiyā dhammā patikkulā honti || ||
sn35.247:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe nādhimuccati || appiyarūpe rūpe na vyāpajjati upaṭṭhitakāyasatī ca viharati appamāṇacetaso ||
sn35.247:4.3: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtam pajānāti || yathassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti || la ||
sn35.247:4.5: Manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme nādhimuccati || appiyarūpe dhamme na vyāpajjati || upaṭṭhitakāyasatī ca viharati appamaṇacetaso ||
sn35.247:4.6: tañ ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttim yathābhūtam pajānāti || yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti || || 7
sn35.247:5.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso chappāṇake gahetvā nānāvisaye nānāgocare daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya ||
sn35.247:5.8: daḷhāya rajjuyā bandhitvā daḷhe khīle vā thambhe vā upanibandheyya ||
sn35.247:5.9: atha kho te bhikkhave chappāṇakā nānāvisayā nānāgocarā sakaṃ sakaṃ gocaravisayam āviñcheyyuṃ ||
sn35.247:5.10: ahi āviñcheyya vammikaṃ pavekkhāmīti || suṃsumāro āviñcheyya udakam pavekkhāmīti || pakkhī āviñcheyya ākāsaṃ ḍessāmīti || kukkuro aviñcheyya gāmam pavekkhāmīti || sigālo āviñcheyya sīvathikaṃ pavekkhāmīti || makkato āviñcheyya vanaṃ pavekkhāmīti ||
sn35.247:5.11: yadā kho bhikkhave chappāṇakājhattā assu kilantā || atha taṃ eva khīle vā thambhe vā upatiṭṭheyyuṃ upanisīdeyyum upanipajjeyyuṃ ||
sn35.247:5.12: evam eva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kāyagatā sati bhāvitā bahulīkatā || taṃ cakkhuṃ nāviñchati manāpiyesu rūpesu amanāpiyā rūpā na paṭikkulā honti || pa || jivhā nāviñchati || pe ||
sn35.247:5.13: mano nāviñchati manāpiyesu dhammesu amanapiyā dhammā na paṭikkulā honti || ||
sn35.247:6.1: Daḷhe khīle vā thambe vā ti kho bhikkhave kāyagatāya satiyā etam adhivacanaṃ ||
sn35.247:6.2: tasmāti ha vo bhikkhave etaṃ sikkhitabbam
sn35.247:6.3: Kāyagatā no sati bhāvitā bhavissati bahulīkatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhāti || ||
